question_text: A newly appointed government employee, Ms. Tan, is attending an orientation on RA 6713. The trainer emphasizes that public office is a public trust. Which of the following statements best reflects this principle as declared in the law?

options.text: Public officials may prioritize their personal interests as long as they do not conflict with their duties.
Public officials must serve the public with utmost responsibility, integrity, loyalty, and efficiency.
Public officials are allowed to accept gifts as long as they are disclosed in their annual statement of assets.
Public officials may use government resources for personal purposes if they reimburse the government.
